title: Jesse visits the Richter island site at Bariloche

tellings.quote: Yeah, I've been there actually. I've seen it. A little island off the off the coast of Baroce.

plain: Michels says he has been to the small island off the coast of Bariloche, in Argentina, that is tied to a scientist named Ronald Richter. It comes up while he talks with the researcher Jason Jorjani about Nazi programmes to build flying craft: "I've been there actually. I've seen it." Michels tells it as his own visit, and if the stories about the place are true, he has stood where a secret project tied to that history once ran.
